summary.content:
Today's selection covers 71 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 40 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft and OpenAI Loosen Their Partnership
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: UNC6692 Uses Email Bombing, Social Engineering to Deploy ‘Snow’ Malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 36 articles published in the last 24 hours
